The part acts as the cathode and attracts the negatively charged paint particles. In the current work, the e-coating is performed in 2 steps: soaked at a temperature (T1) at or above 180oC for 20 minutes and then at 171oC for 10 minutes and there are 3 e- coating conditions with T1=180oC (EC180), T1=190oC (EC190) and T1=200oC (EC200). Microstructural characterization is performed on as-cast (F-temper) plates, assuming E-coating will not influence the meso- scale microstructures (i.e. eutectics and dendrites). After e-coatings, tensile tests and bending tests are performed to test the material performances in tension and bending. Tension tests are performed for F-temper, EC180, EC190 and EC200 plates.
